name: Squeekchain
steps: Use only squeekchain.com and docs.squeekchain.com, both linked from @squeekchain .
Link your X account. A whitelist place needs an X account at least one year old.
Link a Discord account that is at least 365 days old for the Discord badge.
If you held a listed NFT at its snapshot, link that wallet. Buying one now won't count, because the snapshots have passed.
Earn more Aura by inviting friends, playing Exsqueektion while the hamster is on stream, or building a project.
Check your rank on the Genesis leaderboard and watch @squeekchain for mint details.
what: Squeekchain has no token airdrop. Its Aura campaign ranks members for whitelist places on a paid Squeek NFT mint. No price, date or team is published.
behind: Squeekchain hasn't said. No page names a founder, a company or a jurisdiction. The only identities are the X accounts @squeekchain, created in August 2026, and @squeektoshi for the hamster. The whitepaper refers to an unnamed team that keeps 111 Squeeks and a quarter of pool fees. We found no funding round in the news and no audit. Its Discord had 2,608 members on 3 November 2026. costs: Joining the ranking costs nothing but a signature. The prize is where the money comes in. The mint is paid in ETH, and the whitepaper lists "| Sale price | TBD |". The docs say "Minting opens in phases, with limits per transaction and per address." The minting page says the mint hasn't begun and gives no price or date.
